manual_annotation.method: Parent-provided approximate visually reviewed full-board corners; not runtime detection.
manual_annotation.aspect_ratio_status: unverified sensitivity candidates; no board ID or class used

protocol.candidate_selection: 10 fixed source/ROI/context/warp candidates x 4 rotations, all preserved.

prompts.collapsed_ruins: a photo of collapsed buildings and earthquake rubble.
prompts.damaged_vehicle: a photo of a damaged wrecked vehicle.
prompts.landslide: a photo of a landslide with soil and rocks covering a road.
prompts.rescue_camp: a photo of a rescue camp with emergency tents and supplies.
prompts.trapped_people: a photo of people trapped under rubble being rescued.
prompts.window_bird: a photo of a bird flying in the sky.
prompts.window_target: a photo of a rescue drone, a quadcopter flying in the sky.

image_encoder.preprocess:
Compose(
    Resize(size=224, interpolation=bicubic, max_size=None, antialias=True)
    CenterCrop(size=(224, 224))
    <function _convert_image_to_rgb at 0x000001D02344CB80>
    ToTensor()
    Normalize(mean=(0.48145466, 0.4578275, 0.40821073), std=(0.26862954, 0.26130258, 0.27577711))
)

limitations: All 40 variants share one JPEG and are not independent observations.
54 source pixels vertically; projective interpolation and padding create no new measured detail.
Approximate corners and assumed output aspect ratios can change scores.
Fixed CLIP acceptance is an uncalibrated exploratory candidate, not a truth label.
All 12 annotated third-party references are neighbors, not verified current simulator textures.
Source is retained diagnostic JPEG, not original raw camera bytes; no new image is acquired.
